note: The public version ladder, rendered onto index.html by the site kit (docs/kit/build.mjs). The rungs after v0.23.0 follow the order the old site published ("one phase per build", v0.24.0 to v0.33.0, then v1.0.0); there is no private roadmap in this repository to hold them to. `summary` is written for the site. States: done, planned, goal, later.

rungs.summary: The first public build: file-name search kept current by each system's own change journal, the query language, the app and its settings, in eighteen languages on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Must-have features, part 1 of 3: duplicates, empty folders, Everything's file lists, and every action on a result from its right-click menu.
Must-have features, part 2 of 3: the index follows the disk live, Index Health, renaming in bulk with undo, unplugged drives that stay searchable, and a command line for scripts.

Must-have features, part 3 of 3, and the stable release: portable mode, audio and video in the preview, Quick Look, a regular-expression builder, and a report of the folders search cannot see. Its fix release, 0.23.2, is the current version.

rungs.phase: Build 4 — Property lens: images and video
rungs.summary: The property lens for images and video: dimensions, camera data, codecs and duration, searchable and shown as columns.

rungs.phase: Build 5 — Property lens: documents, binaries and packages
rungs.summary: The property lens for documents, programs and packages: authors and page counts, architectures and signatures, installers, shortcuts, archives, fonts, mail and databases.

rungs.phase: Build 6 — Music tags and audio pro
rungs.summary: Music tags, and more for people who work with audio.
Tags, notes and collections for your files.
Power search: macros, snapshots, monitors and file hashes.
A launcher, and closer ties to your operating system.
The command line, a terminal interface, and automation.

rungs.phase: Build 13 — LAN, catalogs and index pro
rungs.summary: Searching across your local network, catalogues, and index tools for power users.
The code and knowledge lenses, and the release: version 1.0.
